assessments.title: Physical assessment
assessments.emptyHint: The first one becomes the baseline.
assessments.notePlaceholder: What happened in this session that a number can’t hold.
assessments.deleteText: The {{date}} collection goes with all of its measurements. This cannot be undone.
assessments.methodWarning: Skinfolds and bioimpedance should not be filled in the same assessment: each method uses a different formula, and combining them produces results that disagree with each other. Pick one per collection.
assessments.fillHighlighted: Fill in the highlighted skinfolds to get a result.
assessments.weltmanHint: Abdomen 1 at the narrowest point between the last rib and the iliac crest; abdomen 2 at navel level. The protocol uses the average of the two.
assessments.notUsedByProtocol: Not used by the chosen protocol — fill it in to track it anyway.
assessments.compareHint: Last collection against the previous one.
assessments.detailEmpty: This session was saved with no measurements.
assessments.compareHelp: Tick two or more sessions to compare the photos side by side.
assessments.compareZoomHint: Pinch to zoom, drag to move around. Tap a photo to see it on its own.
assessments.compareNoPhotos: No photos in the chosen sessions.
assessments.compareNoPhotosHint: Pick sessions that have photos, or upload them in the assessment.
assessments.noPrevious: Only one assessment so far — the comparison starts at the second.
assessments.noResultHint: Measurements are missing for this method.
assessments.needsSex: Set the person’s sex: the body-fat formulas differ for each.
assessments.draftPendingHint: Started on {{date}} and saved automatically so far. Pick up where you left off.
assessments.discardText: Everything typed into this measurement goes. This cannot be undone.
assessments.autoFailed: Could not save — check your connection
assessments.photoHint: Four angles per session: PNG, JPG or WEBP. Drag the photo onto the angle's box, or click to pick a file. The image is resized in the browser before uploading.
assessments.photoInvalid: That image could not be read.
assessments.photoCropHint: Drag to position and pinch with two fingers to zoom.
assessments.printHint: Use Ctrl+P (or ⌘+P) and choose “Save as PDF” to send it by email.
assessments.photoRemoveText: The photo for this angle goes from this collection. This cannot be undone.
assessments.photoSidesExplain: The angles your team shoots in every session. The four defaults suit body composition; stage-prep coaches swap them for poses.
assessments.photoSidesOrderHint: The order is the shooting order — drag to change it. Renaming an angle does not touch the photos already uploaded to it, and a renamed angle stops being translated.
assessments.photoSidesEmpty: No angles. The photo section does not appear in the assessment.
assessments.photoSidesRestoreText: The list goes back to front, right side, left side and back. Photos already uploaded stay saved.
assessments.photoSidesRemoveText: "{{name}}" leaves the next sessions. Photos already uploaded to this angle stay saved and keep showing in the history.

profile.vocabularyTitle: What you call the people you follow
profile.vocabularyExplain: A trainer says student, an endocrinologist says patient, a consultancy says client. It is the same record — only the word shown in menus, titles and buttons changes, and only for you.
profile.vocabularySaved: Done! The app is already using that word.
profile.vocabularyPreview: It will look like this: menu <0>{{plural}}</0>, button <1>{{newLabel}}</1>.

profile.templatesEmpty: No template yet. Create the first one and it shows up when building a workout.
profile.templateTipPlaceholder: What you usually advise on this workout
profile.autoFillExplain: Texts you repeat, saved field by field. The form shows an <0>Autofill</0> next to each of these fields, with your options — and from there you can also save the text you have just written.
profile.languageExplain: Changes GoFitNow's menus, titles and buttons, and only for you. It does not touch the word you chose under Vocabulary, nor anything already written in the records and workouts.
profile.usernameHint: Optional. Lets you sign in without typing the whole e-mail. Letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore.
profile.bioHint: Shows on your booking page, for people who don't know you yet. Each page chooses whether to show it.
profile.bioPlaceholder: E.g.: Personal trainer for 12 years, specialised in functional training and rehab.
